question: What is the outlook for Childhood Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia ?
ground_truth: Certain factors affect prognosis (chance of recovery) and treatment options. For leukemia that relapses (comes back) after treatment, the prognosis and treatment options depend partly on the following: - How long it is between the time of diagnosis and when the leukemia comes back. - Whether the leukemia comes back in the bone marrow or in other parts of the body.
